notes: v0.17.6 is the first base release with published assets since v0.16.1. The tag object 2bc79966 points at c9bc6c0f, the squash merge of the v0.17.6 release-material PR #428; the four release assets were verified against their own .sha256 sidecars and re-hashed locally after materialization. Release Gate run 40431521256 and Foundation Release Verify run 40433836341 are both success on the tagged commit, and the bundle's verification-summary.json still only declares the six required checks without per-check results, so those results were read back from the GitHub API instead of asserted from the bundle. The release is not schema-neutral: base migrations now run to 000030 (tenant_plans) and the menu seed moves 租户管理 under a new 租户运营 group with five new permission codes, so the ops swap must re-verify the schema guard, the menu/permission contract checks and the business smoke expectations.
